tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: The register identity of one entity by exact id (country + the national id, the part after "LT:" of a public id; resolve_entity finds it from a name), plus the enriched blocks asked for in include: financials, workforce, tax, debt, insolvency, procurement, score. A block is null when it is not asked
